src/vllm/install-vllm.sh

Shell · Tier B

Install or verify a named Linux NVIDIA vLLM development environment.

Usage

Create a fresh Conda environment, or use --verify-only for an existing environment.

Inputs

Conda environment name, optional --verify-only, CONDA_HOME and CUDA-visible devices. Requires Linux x86_64/aarch64, working NVIDIA drivers and network access for installation.

Side effects

May download Miniforge, create Python 3.12 environment and install selected vLLM/PyTorch dependencies; verification probes CUDA/import readiness without launching a model.

Cleanup

Temporary download handling belongs to the installer; failed named environments may remain for inspection. Existing environment names are rejected for new installs.

@see src/vllm/vllm_install_support.py

@see src/vllm/README.md

src/vllm/nano_v3_reasoning_parser.py

Python · Tier A

Adapt vLLM's DeepSeek-style reasoning extraction for Nano V3 responses.

Details

NanoV3ReasoningParser preserves the parent parser while accounting for the request's chat-template thinking setting. Registration makes the adapter selectable by the local launch profile. This module changes response parsing, not generation settings.

src/vllm/start-can3a-max-ornith1.5-35b-a3b-official-q6-gguf-vllm-3gpu.sh

Shell · Tier B

Probe the experimental vLLM plugin with a local Ornith Q6 GGUF.

Usage

Requires the installed GGUF plugin and cached model/tokenizer files; Q6 defaults to context 262144, one sequence and port 8000. This profile is not qualification evidence.

Inputs

MODEL_FILE, TOKENIZER_PATH, HF_CONFIG_PATH, VLLM_BIN and runtime overrides; three pipeline stages use layer partition 26,8,6.

Side effects

Validates local prerequisites and execs vllm serve with a constructed argument array. The wrapper does not download weights; plugin/runtime startup can still fail.

Cleanup

The vLLM process owns its worker/GPU shutdown; cached model and tokenizer files persist.

@see src/vllm/README.md

src/vllm/vllm_qwen3next_patch/sitecustomize.py

Python · Tier A

Runtime vLLM compatibility patch for Qwen3-Next CPU offload.

Details

vLLM 0.19.0 initializes the input batch before Qwen3-Next's hybrid attention and Mamba KV-cache layout is fully resolved. The resolved layout then needs the input batch to be rebuilt, but vLLM blocks that path when UVA CPU weight offload is enabled. This shim keeps the original rebuild logic and only bypasses that guard while the rebuild decision runs.
